entradas_salidas.name: entradas_salidas
entradas_salidas.definition: select `es`.`id` AS `id`,`es`.`subarticle_id` AS `subarticle_id`,`r`.`delivery_date` AS `fecha`,'' AS `factura`,cast(NULL as date) AS `nota_entrega`,`r`.`nro_solicitud` AS `nro_pedido`,concat(`u`.`name`,' - ',`u`.`title`) AS `detalle`,-`es`.`total_delivered` AS `cantidad`,0 AS `costo_unitario`,`es`.`request_id` AS `modelo_id`,'salida' AS `tipo`,`r`.`created_at` AS `created_at`,`r`.`cite_ems` AS `cite_ems_plantillas` from ((`dwms_bd`.`requests` `r` join `dwms_bd`.`subarticle_requests` `es` on(`r`.`id` = `es`.`request_id`)) join `dwms_bd`.`users` `u` on(`r`.`user_id` = `u`.`id`)) where `r`.`invalidate` = 0 and `es`.`invalidate` = 0 and `r`.`status` = 'delivered' union select `es`.`id` AS `id`,`es`.`subarticle_id` AS `subarticle_id`,ifnull(`ne`.`note_entry_date`,`es`.`date`) AS `fecha`,`ne`.`invoice_number` AS `factura`,`ne`.`delivery_note_date` AS `nota_entrega`,'' AS `nro_pedido`,if(`ne`.`supplier_id`,(select `s`.`name` from `dwms_bd`.`suppliers` `s` where `s`.`id` = `ne`.`supplier_id`),if(`ne`.`reingreso` = 1,'REINGRESO',if(`ne`.`tipo_ingreso` = 'donacion_transferencia','DONACION O TRANSFERENCIA','SALDO INICIAL'))) AS `detalle`,`es`.`amount` AS `cantidad`,`es`.`unit_cost` AS `costo_unitario`,`es`.`note_entry_id` AS `modelo_id`,'entrada' AS `tipo`,`es`.`created_at` AS `created_at`,`ne`.`documento_cite` AS `cite_ems_plantillas` from (`dwms_bd`.`entry_subarticles` `es` left join `dwms_bd`.`note_entries` `ne` on(`es`.`note_entry_id` = `ne`.`id`)) where `es`.`invalidate` = 0 order by `subarticle_id`,`fecha`,`id`,`cantidad` desc,`created_at`

master_ingreso.name: master_ingreso
master_ingreso.definition: select `dwms_bd`.`subarticles`.`code` AS `code`,`dwms_bd`.`subarticles`.`description` AS `description`,`dwms_bd`.`subarticles`.`unit` AS `unit`,`dwms_bd`.`subarticles`.`status` AS `status`,`dwms_bd`.`subarticles`.`article_id` AS `article_id`,`dwms_bd`.`subarticles`.`created_at` AS `created_at`,`dwms_bd`.`subarticles`.`updated_at` AS `updated_at`,`dwms_bd`.`subarticles`.`amount` AS `amount`,`dwms_bd`.`subarticles`.`minimum` AS `minimum`,`dwms_bd`.`subarticles`.`barcode` AS `barcode`,`dwms_bd`.`subarticles`.`material_id` AS `material_id`,`dwms_bd`.`subarticles`.`code_old` AS `code_old`,`dwms_bd`.`subarticles`.`incremento` AS `incremento`,`dwms_bd`.`materials`.`code` AS `code_materials`,`dwms_bd`.`materials`.`description` AS `descrition_material`,`dwms_bd`.`materials`.`status` AS `status_material`,`dwms_bd`.`entry_subarticles`.`amount` AS `amount_sub`,`dwms_bd`.`entry_subarticles`.`unit_cost` AS `unit_cost`,`dwms_bd`.`entry_subarticles`.`total_cost` AS `total_cost`,`dwms_bd`.`entry_subarticles`.`invoice` AS `invoice`,`dwms_bd`.`entry_subarticles`.`date` AS `date`,`dwms_bd`.`entry_subarticles`.`subarticle_id` AS `subarticle_id`,`dwms_bd`.`entry_subarticles`.`created_at` AS `create_entry`,`dwms_bd`.`entry_subarticles`.`stock` AS `stock`,`dwms_bd`.`entry_subarticles`.`note_entry_id` AS `note_entry_id`,`dwms_bd`.`entry_subarticles`.`invalidate` AS `invalidate` from ((`dwms_bd`.`subarticles` join `dwms_bd`.`materials` on(`dwms_bd`.`materials`.`id` = `dwms_bd`.`subarticles`.`material_id`)) join `dwms_bd`.`entry_subarticles` on(`dwms_bd`.`entry_subarticles`.`subarticle_id` = `dwms_bd`.`subarticles`.`id`)) where `dwms_bd`.`entry_subarticles`.`stock` > 0 order by `dwms_bd`.`subarticles`.`description`

pedidos_temporales.name: pedidos_temporales
pedidos_temporales.definition: select `dwms_bd`.`t_temporal_pedidos`.`code_item` AS `code_item`,sum(`dwms_bd`.`t_temporal_pedidos`.`cantidad_item`) AS `totalReservas` from `dwms_bd`.`t_temporal_pedidos` group by `dwms_bd`.`t_temporal_pedidos`.`code_item`

usersjson1.name: usersjson1
usersjson1.definition: select `dwms_bd`.`users`.`id` AS `id`,`dwms_bd`.`users`.`name` AS `nombre`,`dwms_bd`.`users`.`ci` AS `numero_documento`,`dwms_bd`.`users`.`title` AS `cargo`,`dwms_bd`.`users`.`department_id` AS `department_id`,`dwms_bd`.`departments`.`name` AS `unidad`,`dwms_bd`.`departments`.`id` AS `id_departament`,`dwms_bd`.`users`.`email` AS `email` from (`dwms_bd`.`users` join `dwms_bd`.`departments` on(`dwms_bd`.`departments`.`code` = `dwms_bd`.`users`.`department_id`))

user_json.name: user_json
user_json.definition: select `dwms_bd`.`users`.`id` AS `id`,`dwms_bd`.`users`.`name` AS `nombre`,`dwms_bd`.`users`.`ci` AS `numero_documento`,`dwms_bd`.`users`.`title` AS `cargo`,`dwms_bd`.`users`.`department_id` AS `department_id`,`dwms_bd`.`departments`.`name` AS `unidad`,`dwms_bd`.`departments`.`id` AS `id_departament`,`dwms_bd`.`users`.`email` AS `email` from (`dwms_bd`.`users` join `dwms_bd`.`departments` on(`dwms_bd`.`departments`.`id` = `dwms_bd`.`users`.`department_id`))
